title: Mirabel and the Spire
author: Mirabel Kavanagh
blurb: Jonah Kavanagh, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
